# nd_config_deploy (Resource)

Triggers fabric configuration save (recalculate) and/or deployment operations on an ND-managed fabric. This is an action resource — it executes config-save and deploy operations rather than managing a persistent API object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_config_deploy" "test_resource_config_deploy_1" {
  fabric_name                       = "my_fabric"
  deploy                            = true
  config_save                       = true
  switch_ids                        = ["ALL"]
  force_show_run                    = false
  include_all_fabric_group_switches = false
  always_deploy                     = false
  ticket_id                         = "Ticket_001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Name of the fabric to perform config-save and/or deploy on

### Optional

- `always_deploy` (Boolean) When false (default), the operations are executed only once during the initial create and are not re-executed on subsequent `terraform apply` runs. When true, the operations are always executed on every apply, which shows as an update to the resource in the plan.
- `behaviour` (Attributes) Controls when the config-save and deploy operations are executed during the Terraform resource lifecycle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--behaviour))
- `config_save` (Boolean) When true, perform a config-save (recalculate) operation on the fabric before deployment. Also known as recalculate in the API.
- `deploy` (Boolean) When true, deploy the fabric configuration to switches after config-save. At least one of `deploy` or `config_save` must be true.
- `force_show_run` (Boolean) When true, fetch the latest running configuration from each switch instead of using the cached version before deployment.
- `include_all_fabric_group_switches` (Boolean) When true and the target is a fabric group, deploy changes to switches in all member fabrics. Only applicable for fabric-wide deploy.
- `switch_ids` (Set of String) List of switch serial numbers or IP addresses to deploy configuration to. Use `["ALL"]` to deploy to all switches in the fabric. When omitted, a fabric-wide deploy is performed. Note: IP address support is TBD
- `ticket_id` (String) Change Control ticket ID to associate with the config-save operation. Must begin with a letter; remaining characters may be letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Length: 1–64 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the config_deploy resource
- `status` (String) Status message from the last config-save or deploy operation. Read-only, populated by NDFC after the operation completes.

<a id="nestedatt--behaviour"></a>
### Nested Schema for `behaviour`

Optional:

- `deploy_on_create` (Boolean) When true, execute config-save and/or deploy when the resource is created.
- `deploy_on_destroy` (Boolean) When true, execute config-save and/or deploy when the resource is destroyed. Useful for deploying configuration removal to switches.
- `deploy_on_update` (Boolean) When true, execute config-save and/or deploy when the resource is updated.
